categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in four business segments: titanium alloy precision casting, rubber and sealing materials, aircraft cockpit transparent components, and high-temperature alloy master alloys. These segments focus on aerospace applications including aircraft engines, airframes, helicopters, and spacecraft, as well as extending to shipbuilding, weaponry, electronics, nuclear industry, railways, bridges, chemical, automotive, and biomedical fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced titanium alloy casting with high precision and complex structures, specialized rubber and sealing material formulations with high temperature and corrosion resistance, integrated manufacturing of organic and inorganic glass transparent cockpit components, and vacuum induction melting and casting of high-temperature superalloys. The company employs digital simulation, additive manufacturing, and strict quality control systems such as NADCAP certification to ensure product performance and reliability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major domestic and international aerospace engine and aircraft manufacturers, including military and civil aviation sectors. The company also serves downstream industries such as shipbuilding, defense, electronics, nuclear power, automotive, and biomedical sectors. Major clients include China Aviation Industry Group, China Aviation Engine Group, Safran, Honeywell, and other global aerospace companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales in domestic aerospace and related industries. It also has international customers, particularly in Europe and North America, with long-term contracts extending to 2030. Export sales account for a smaller portion of revenue but are strategically important for global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and upstream segments of the aerospace materials supply chain, focusing on research, development, and manufacturing of advanced materials and components. It supplies critical parts and materials to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and tier-one suppliers in the aerospace industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation in lightweight high-performance materials, digital and intelligent manufacturing, and green manufacturing processes. R&D focuses on overcoming key technical bottlenecks in titanium alloy casting, rubber sealing materials, transparent cockpit components, and high-temperature superalloys. The company emphasizes 'unveiling and tackling' critical projects, expanding patent portfolios, and integrating industry-academia-research collaborations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aerospace-grade materials and components, including titanium alloy castings, rubber and sealing products, transparent cockpit components, and high-temperature alloy master alloys. The company also earns income from processing services and technology service contracts, with pricing based on negotiated contracts, military pricing approvals, and competitive bidding.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading domestic position in aerospace materials, especially in titanium alloy precision casting and high-temperature alloy master alloys. It competes with international aerospace material suppliers such as PCC, Howmet Aerospace, Safran, Honeywell, Dow Corning, Hutchinson, and PPG. The company is recognized as a key supplier to major aerospace OEMs and maintains advanced technological capabilities to sustain its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.93 billion, representing a 4.62% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 581 million, a 0.84% increase. R&D investment increased by 18.78% to RMB 242 million, accounting for 8.26% of revenue. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 11.73 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 10.36 billion, reflecting steady growth and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive technological capabilities, including proprietary advanced casting and material processing technologies, high precision and quality standards, and integrated R&D and production systems. It offers high-performance, lightweight, and reliable aerospace materials with certifications meeting international standards. Its ability to deliver complex, large-scale, and multifunctional components with strong after-sales technical support differentiates it in the aerospace materials market.
